questions.solution: f(3) = 2(3) + 1 = 7, so the statement is true.

course_materials: A linear function has the form f(x) = ax + b.

exam.title: Algebra and Functions Quiz
exam.subject: Mathematics
exam.instructions: Answer all four questions. Show your reasoning for question 4.

questions.solution: Subtract 3 to obtain 2x = 4, then divide by 2: x = 2.
Expand to 3x - 6 = 2x + 5. Subtract 2x and add 6: x = 11.

questions.stem: For f(x) = 2x + 1, f(3) = 7. True or false?
questions.solution: f(3) = 2(3) + 1 = 7, so the statement is true.

questions.stem: If f(x) = ax + b, f(1) = 5, and f(3) = 11, what is f(5)?
questions.solution: The slope is (11 - 5)/(3 - 1) = 3. Then b = 2 and f(5) = 17.
